title: Ledger and Bridge
author: Casper Lockridge
blurb: Emrys Lockridge, a widowed lighthouse keeper during the year of the great storms, keeps a low profile and busy hands. But when the census taker asks one question too many, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must smuggle the evidence past three checkpoints before the armistice is signed — or isn't.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
